cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Understand the Hurt
cards.instruction: Make someone acknowledge why their action hurt, not merely agree that it happened.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You remember how I made you pick one friendly face before a concert? I saved you the front-row seat at mine.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I told you work might run late.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes. You've learned to give a warning. But I looked at that empty chair before every song. Tell me what I was looking for.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Someone who knew what getting through those songs meant to you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's it. You used to tell me any friendly face would do. Do you understand now why I couldn't just choose another one?

reason: Let the familiar mentor-pupil habits shape the request, correction or concession. Preserve B actual contribution while allowing A to need help without explaining the combination to an evaluator.
